items.reason: This is the adapalene gel you asked for, used at night to help keep breakout-prone skin looking clearer.
A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the routine from stacking irritation on top of adapalene.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a skin barrier that looks a bit dry and helps with comfort while your skin adjusts.
Daily mineral sunscreen is a must alongside adapalene, which can make skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Start adapalene a few nights a week with a pea-sized amount on dry skin, then build up as your skin tolerates it, and use sunscreen every morning. Skip other exfoliating acids or strong actives for now so skin has time to adjust.
